scope_note: This reports Freud's 1912 theoretical boundary: analysis was said to reveal and use transference, not uniquely create it.
statement: Freud argued in 1912 that intense transference also occurred outside analytic treatment and should not be attributed to psychoanalysis itself.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1912 年主張，強烈移情也會出現在分析治療之外，不應歸因為精神分析本身所創造。
